summary: Implemented a reusable append-only create-if-absent retry helper for concurrent main movement. On failed create it rereads the exact deterministic path first: an existing path is authoritative LOST_RACE; an absent path retries only when the failure normalizes to HEAD_MOVED/CAS conflict, after refreshing head, and always retries the same path. Unknown failures abort and retry count is bounded. Added a node:test suite exercising the current /wc beacon path shape; 5/5 tests passed. No existing append-only evidence was updated and no Current/Human Accepted/Served/production authority was changed.
tests: PASS: unrelated head movement -> reread absent path -> refresh head -> CREATE exact same path -> CREATED.
PASS: path appears after failed CREATE -> LOST_RACE with winner evidence and no second authority path.
PASS: unknown/non-retryable failure on absent path -> ABORTED, no variant-path fallback.
PASS: retry budget bounded; all attempts preserve one deterministic path.
PASS: current /wc beacon path shape coordination/workers/beacons/wc-test-atomic.json exercised by the harness.
PASS: no existing append-only file was overwritten; no Current, Catalog, Lineage, Human Accepted, Served or production /w pointer modified.
unresolved: Host adapters that expose different conflict metadata should normalize their errors to HEAD_MOVED/PATH_MAY_EXIST semantics before using this helper; this does not block the reusable primitive itself.

spawn_candidates.title: Wire append-only retry helper into a concrete /wc host adapter canary
spawn_candidates.reason: The reusable primitive is implemented and unit-tested; a bounded integration canary can now prove host-specific conflict normalization without broad control-plane mutation.
acceptance: One real create-if-absent call-site uses the helper or an equivalent adapter contract.
A synthetic unrelated-main-movement conflict retries the exact same absent path.
A real/synthetic path-exists race returns LOST_RACE and creates no variant authority path.
No Current/Human Accepted/Served/production promotion is inferred.
